errors.text_span: 两个饼图均包含七个类别
errors.evidence: Chart (a) has 8 categories/slices, while chart (b) has 7. It is incorrect to state that both have seven.

errors.text_span: 预测为空（白色）、一个为0（浅灰色）、预测过长（中灰色）、预测过短（深灰色）、下一层级（浅灰色）、上一层次（中灰色）、超出NTC（深灰色）以及“其他”（黑色）
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly applies the 8 categories from chart (a) to both charts. Chart (b) does not contain the category '超出NTC' and has only 7 categories in total.
In chart (a), the '预测过短' (Predicted too short) slice is 16%, not 17%. The 17% slice corresponds to '下一层级' (Next level).
In chart (a), the '预测过长' (Predicted too long) slice is 18%, not 16%. The 16% slice corresponds to '预测过短' (Predicted too short).
In chart (a), the '一个为0' (One is 0) slice is 0%, not 18%. The 18% slice corresponds to '预测过长' (Predicted too long).
In chart (a), the '下一层级' (Next level) slice is 17%, not 6%. The 6% slice corresponds to '上一层级' (Previous level).
In chart (a), the '上一层次' (Previous level) slice is 6%, not 3%. The two 3% slices correspond to '超出NTC' (Exceeds NTC) and '其他' (Other).
In chart (a), the '其他' (Other) slice is 3%, not 0%. The 0% slice corresponds to '一个为0' (One is 0).
In chart (b), the '上一层次' (Previous level) slice is 9%, not 6%. One of the 6% slices corresponds to '下一层级' (Next level) and the other to '其他' (Other).
The description reports a slice for '超出NTC' (Exceeds NTC) in chart (b), but this category does not exist in chart (b). The 9% slice actually corresponds to '上一层次' (Previous level).

The description incorrectly states that no legend is seen. Both charts have a list of categories next to them that functions as a legend, associating category names with the visual representation in the pie chart.
